text:
Maya: quick WIP — putting an outline for a unified warmup state machine for all weight sources (safetensors, mmap, gzipped bundles, manifest-sidecar). want to consolidate fallbacks + kvcache hydration logic so runtime-level hotstart is predictable.

Liam: sg. is the goal to have a single state enum we can run in the worker, or a coordinator that sequences format adapters?

Maya: single state machine API surface exposed to serving runtime (worker) + small format adapters that implement a few callbacks (probe, stream, finalise). coordinator will only orchestrate priority/credit, not format parsing.

Devin: can you paste a rough state enum?

Maya: sure — rough draft: ```
State:
  INIT -> TRY_INDEX -> STREAM_HEADER -> PREFETCH_CHUNKS -> HYDRATE_KV -> VERIFY -> ACTIVATED -> ERROR/RETRY
Transitions driven by: adapter.capabilities, prefetch_budget, kvcache_hit, file_signature
```

Sara: love it. for safetensors we can fast-path to TRY_INDEX -> ACTIVATED if index-first present. for mmapped checkpoints we go INIT -> STREAM_HEADER -> ACTIVATED (zero-copy).

Liam: fallback question: if index missing and remote bandwidth high, do we attempt progressive streaming and activate partially (prefix-only) or block until full verify?

Maya: runtime SLOs matter. plan: two modes per deployment: "strict" (block/verify before ACTIVATED) and "progressive" (activate when prefix sufficient for kv-cache and apply guardrails: only allow inference for short sequences until VERIFY completes). default hosted -> progressive, dedicated/private -> strict configurable.

Devin: how do adapters signal progressive-compatibility? some formats cannot be safely prefix-activated.

Maya: adapter interface will have `supports_prefix_activation` + `minimal_prefix_bytes_for_kvcache` + `verify_stream` async hook. adapter decides viability.

Sara: telemetry: we need signals for "activated_but_unverified" and "verify_latency" per model-version so Optimize can recommend quantization/pack strategies.

Liam: are we coupling this to the shard registry/manifest service? i.e., manifestless bundles need a different resolution flow.

Maya: yes. resolver returns WeightSource objects with metadata: format, transport, content-length, chunk-map if available. state machine consumes that metadata. manifestless flows get an adapter that can request chunk-range manifests on demand.

infra-bot: deploy note: canary branch "warmup-sm-bridge" deployed to staging cluster (tag: warmup-sm-2026-03-21).

Devin: good. one more thing: eviction semantics. if a shard is evicted mid-VERIFY, we should abort verify and either retry or rollback to previous ACTIVATED snapshot. thoughts?

Maya: propose liveness token per warmup run. eviction cancels the token -> adapter Cancelled error -> state machine either restarts from INIT (retry policy) or rolls back to last known stable mapping. keep retries bounded.

Sara: +1. add a metric for retries-per-activation and for activation-duration-percentiles. also tag by `format_adapter` and `route` (hosted/dedicated).

Liam: any changes needed to the kvcache API? how do we populate partial kv entries during progressive activation?

Maya: kvcache will accept `prefix_hydration` calls with (layer_id, offsets, compressed_chunk) and a `staleness_epoch` header. consumers must check `activation_verification` flag before trusting full attention outputs — runtime will gate certain ops until verify completes.

Devin: sounds doable. can we keep the adapter surface minimal to avoid per-format explosion? e.g., four callbacks: `probe(metadata) -> capabilities`, `open_stream(range)`, `stream_verify(async)`, `finalize()`?

Maya: exactly. keep the RFC confined. we'll add a small shim for gz vs tar vs safetensors but same callback set.

Sara: timeline? I can take a prototype adapter for safetensors and incremental header streaming this sprint.

Maya: awesome — I'll draft a short RFC with state machine diagram + API defs and post by EOD. please dump any edgecases here.

Liam: edgecase: mixed-format bundles (some files safetensors, some quant packs gz) — adapter should surface per-file capabilities and state machine orchestrates per-file subruns.

Devin: edgecase: encrypted shards (KMS) — verify must include decrypt handshake; adapter should expose `requires_decrypt` and `crypto_key_id`.

Sara: noted. I'll include a quick integration test plan: 1) index-first safetensors fastpath 2) streaming safetensors progressive activation 3) mmap local zero-copy 4) eviction-cancel-rollback 5) mixed-format bundle.

Maya: perfect. thanks all. posting RFC link when ready. :rocket:
